description: Sort 1 to 200 versions by SemVer precedence (duplicates removed, invalid ones listed separately) and, if a range is given, return the matching versions plus maxSatisfying / minSatisfying (what npm would install from that list) and the latest stable version. Read-only. Same engine as GET /api/resolve.

includePrerelease.description: Let prereleases match any range they fall inside (npm includePrerelease). Default false (npm behaviour).

items.description: Version: a semantic version such as "1.4.2", "v2.0.0" or "3.0.0-rc.1+build.5".

name: resolve_versions
title: Sort versions and resolve a range
